parole.significato: Sichuan pepper (any of the spice plants under the Zanthoxylum genus and their produce)
parole.testo: On one hand, the distribution of this term and its alternative forms—when compared to that of Persian borrowings such as غَوْشَنَة (ḡawšana) and أُشْتُرْغَار (ʔušturḡār)—suggests that this term is also a Persian borrowing. The variants point to some Persian ***فاگِره (***fāgira); compare Classical P
